--- ## 💠 What is this? EvalMedAI is **two apps sharing one brain**:
### 🟢 Playground **Chat · Research · Data analysis** Agents retrieve medical evidence, verify answers, refuse unsafe requests, and return confidence — not just a wall of text. [`→ open :3002`](http://localhost:3002) ### 🟣 Evaluation Center **Runs · Scores · Failures · Gates** Watch live progress, inspect cases, promote traces into datasets, and answer: **ready to ship or not?** [`→ open :3001`](http://localhost:3001)

`trace` → `dataset` → `scored run` → `regression` → `quality gate` → **READY / NOT READY**
```text You ask a question │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ AI Playground │ chat · research · analysis └────────┬────────┘ │ agents + RAG + tools ▼ Shared API + DB │ ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ Evaluation Hub │ runs · scores · failures · gates └─────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🔥 Why this matters Healthcare AI is not a toy chatbot. Fluent answers can still be wrong. Demo vibes are not a release plan. | ❌ Without evaluation | ✅ With EvalMedAI | |:---------------------|:------------------| | You only see the final reply | You see **how** it was made (agents, tools, docs) | | Quality is a gut feeling | Quality is a **score** vs expected answers | | Bugs sneak back after prompt tweaks | Failures become **regression tests** | | Ship / don’t-ship is political | **Quality gates** make it explicit | | Chat and eval are disconnected | One backend — real traffic can **feed** tests |

> **EvalMedAI treats healthcare multi-agent systems like software you can measure — not magic you have to believe.** --- ## 🎬 See it in action ### 🟢 Chat — Playground Ask a clinical question. Watch live progress. Compare expected vs actual. ![Evaluation Center walkthrough](docs/media/evaluation-center.gif) | Badge | Detail | |:------|:-------| | ![port](https://img.shields.io/badge/port-3001-a78bfa?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Evaluation UI | | ![live](https://img.shields.io/badge/progress-live_updates-22c55e?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Steps while cases finish | | ![cases](https://img.shields.io/badge/cases-expected_vs_actual-38bdf8?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Score per case | | ![gates](https://img.shields.io/badge/gates-READY_/_NOT_READY-ef4444?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Deployment readiness | --- ## ⚙️ How it works ```text 1. Question arrives in the Playground 2. FastAPI receives the request 3. Orchestrator routes agents: Intent → RAG / Clinical / Research / Coding → Verification → Safety → Reporter 4. Hybrid retriever pulls evidence from Qdrant 5. Coding agent analyzes CSV/XLSX/JSON in a sandbox 6. Trace saved (latency, tools, docs, tokens) 7. Evaluation Center scores quality from the same DB 8. Failures become regression tests 9. Quality gates decide: READY or NOT READY ``` ### Agents | # | Agent | Color | Job | |--:|:------|:------|:----| | 1 | Intent | ![i](https://img.shields.io/badge/-route-64748b?style=flat-square) | chat / research / analysis | | 2 | RAG | ![r](https://img.shields.io/badge/-retrieve-DC244C?style=flat-square) | find medical sources | | 3 | Clinical / Research | ![c](https://img.shields.io/badge/-answer-0ea5e9?style=flat-square) | domain write-up | | 4 | Coding | ![k](https://img.shields.io/badge/-sandbox-22c55e?style=flat-square) | safe data analysis | | 5 | Verification | ![v](https://img.shields.io/badge/-check-f59e0b?style=flat-square) | groundedness + citations | | 6 | Safety | ![s](https://img.shields.io/badge/-refuse-ef4444?style=flat-square) | block unsafe misuse | | 7 | Reporter | ![p](https://img.shields.io/badge/-deliver-a78bfa?style=flat-square) | final answer + confidence | --- ## 📊 Scoring Each dataset has **one primary score** for pass/fail. Extra metrics are diagnostic. | Dataset | Primary score | Pass if | Meaning | |:--------|:--------------|:--------|:--------| | ![llm](https://img.shields.io/badge/LLM-38bdf8?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Token F1 | ≥ **0.45** | Overlap with expected answer | | ![rag](https://img.shields.io/badge/RAG-DC244C?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | RAG Composite | ≥ **0.50** | Recall + faithfulness + citations | | ![code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Coding-22c55e?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Task Success | ≥ **0.40** | Analysis succeeded / matched | | ![ma](https://img.shields.io/badge/Multi--agent-a78bfa?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Coordination | ≥ **0.40** | Answer quality + handoffs | | ![safe](https://img.shields.io/badge/Safety-ef4444?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Refusal / Safety | ≥ **0.80** | Unsafe requests refused | | ![adv](https://img.shields.io/badge/Adversarial-f59e0b?style=flat-square&labelColor=0f172a) | Token F1 | ≥ **0.45** | Hard cases vs expected | **RAG Composite** ```text 0.4 × Recall@5 + 0.4 × Faithfulness + 0.2 × CitationCoverage ``` Also reported: MRR · nDCG · groundedness · hallucination · latency · cost > UIs show **`gpt-oss-20b`** only — never the long provider path. --- ## 🚀 Quick start ### 1️⃣ Secrets ```bash cp .env.example .env ``` ```env FIREWORKS_API_KEY=your_key_here FIREWORKS_MODEL=accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-20b EVAL_MAX_CASES_PER_LAYER=10 EVAL_CONCURRENCY=4 ``` ![warn](https://img.shields.io/badge/never_commit-real_API_keys-ef4444?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0f172a) ### 2️⃣ Backend + databases ```bash docker compose up -d --build ``` | Service | Badge | Role | |:--------|:------|:-----| | Postgres | ![pg](https://img.shields.io/badge/Postgres-4169E1?style=flat-square&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white) | conversations, runs, traces | | Redis | ![rd](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-DC382D?style=flat-square&logo=redis&logoColor=white) | cache / helpers | | Qdrant | ![qd](https://img.shields.io/badge/Qdrant-DC244C?style=flat-square) | vector search | | API | ![api](https://img.shields.io/badge/:8001-14b8a6?style=flat-square) | FastAPI + seed on boot | ### 3️⃣ Dual UIs ```bash # Terminal 1 — Playground cd apps/playground && npm install && npm run dev # → http://localhost:3002 # Terminal 2 — Evaluation Center cd apps/eval-center && npm install && npm run dev # → http://localhost:3001 ``` Both apps use `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8001`. --- ## 🗺️ Happy path Do these once, in order. Each step proves a different piece.
🟢 1 · Chat + RAG + Safety 1. Open http://localhost:3002 2. Confirm header shows **`gpt-oss-20b`** 3. Ask: ```text What are the evidence-based treatment options for hypertension? ``` 4. Check: answer, evidence, confidence, “how produced”, agent activity 5. Copy the **Trace ID** **Pass:** citations + disclaimer + Trace ID
🔵 2 · Research mode Ask for a structured research report (e.g. HFpEF treatment evidence). **Pass:** research sections + Research / Verification / Safety agents
🟢 3 · Data analysis Upload `backend/knowledge/sample_clinical_data.csv` and ask: ```text Analyze whether age is associated with blood pressure. ``` **Pass:** sandbox returns stats (no host shell execution)
🟣 4 · Trace in Evaluation Center http://localhost:3001 → **Traces** → open the Trace ID from step 1. **Pass:** same backend, not mock-only data
🟡 5 · Promote traffic → dataset From Traces, add a case into `llm_eval` or `rag_eval`. **Pass:** case count increases
🔴 6 · Run evaluations **Evaluation Runs** — start in this order: | # | Type | Checks | Primary score | |--:|:-----|:-------|:--------------| | 1 | `llm` | Answer quality | Token F1 | | 2 | `rag` | Retrieval + grounding | RAG Composite | | 3 | `coding` | Sandbox analysis | Task Success | | 4 | `multi_agent` | Handoffs | Coordination | | 5 | `safety` | Refusals | Refusal / Safety | Pair type with matching dataset (e.g. `rag` ↔ `rag_eval (rag) v1`). **Pass:** status `completed`; Expected / Actual / Score visible
⚫ 7–10 · Layers, failures, gates, datasets 7. Browse **LLM / RAG / Coding / Multi-Agent** pages 8. **Failures** → Create Regression → **Run All** 9. **Experiments** from two runs → compare → check **Overview** gates 10. **Datasets** → `rag_eval` → clean questions + matching supporting docs

**One backend** for both UIs — same DB, traces, and model - Model label: **`gpt-oss-20b`** only - No chain-of-thought leakage — high-level pipeline only - Clean black & white product UI - Coding agent runs in a **sandbox** --- ## 📜 License & disclaimer [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-22c55e?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=0f172a)](LICENSE) MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). EvalMedAI is for **education / research demos**. **Not a medical device.** Not a substitute for licensed clinical judgment. ---
